arabic_title: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي الرِّضَا إذا نَظَرَ الى  اَصحابِ الدُنيا
english_title: 35. In Satisfaction when he Looked upon the Companions of this world

phrases.english: 1.Praise belongs to God in satisfaction with God's decision!

phrases.arabic: شَهِدْتُ أَنَّ اللهَ قَسَمَ مَعَايِشَ عِبَادِهِ بِالْعَدْلِ ،
phrases.english: 2.I bear witness that God has apportioned the livelihoods of His servants with justice
3.and undertaken bounty for all His creatures.
4.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
5.tempt me not with what You hast given to Your creatures

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَفْتِنْهُمْ بِمَا مَنَعْتَنِي فَأحْسُدَ خَلْقَكَ، وَأَغْمِطَ حُكْمَكَ.
phrases.english: 6.and tempt them not with what You hast withheld from me, lest I envy Your creatures and despise Your decision!
7.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
8.delight my soul through Your decree,
9.expand my breast through the instances of Your decision,
10.give to me a trust through which I may admit

phrases.arabic: بِأََنَّ قَضَاءَكَ لَمْ يَجْرِ إلاَّ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
phrases.english: 11.that Your decree runs only to the best,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ شُكْرِي لَكَ عَلَى مَا زَوَيْتَ عَنّي
phrases.english: 12.and let my gratitude to You for what You hast taken away from me

phrases.arabic: أَوْفَرَ مِنْ شُكْرِي إيَّاكَ عَلَى مَا خَوَّلْتَنِي
phrases.english: 13.be more abundant than my gratitude to You for what You hast conferred upon me!

phrases.arabic: وَاعْصِمْنِي مِن أنْ أظُنَّ بِذِي عَدْم خَسَاسَةً،
phrases.english: 14.Preserve me from imagining any meanness in someone who is destitute
15.or imagining any superiority in someone who possesses wealth,
16.for the noble is he whom obedience to You has ennobled
17.and the exalted is he whom worship of You has exalted!
18.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَمَتِّعْنَا بِثَرْوَة لاَ تَنْفَدُ، وَأَيِّدْنَا بِعِزٍّ لاَ يُفْقَدُ
phrases.english: 19.give us to enjoy a wealth which does not run out, confirm us with an exaltation which will never be lost,
20.and let us roam freely in the kingdom of everlastingness!
21.Surely You art the One, 'the Unique, the Eternal Refuge;
22.You hast not begotten, nor hast You been begotten,
23.and equal to You is not any one' (ref.112:1-4)!
